description: START HERE for any Swiss data question not obviously covered by a specific tool. Searches all connected catalogues at once: opendata.swiss (12'000+ datasets), the federal geodata layers (geo.admin.ch, ~900 layers + STAC), BFS STAT-TAB statistical tables, LINDAS statistical cubes, cantonal/SBB Opendatasoft portals, SNB data, and returns ranked hits. Every hit includes `next`: the exact tool and arguments that fetch the actual data (invoke it directly, or via call_tool if that tool isn't loaded). Example queries: 'rent prices Zürich', 'Strassenlärm', 'Übernachtungen Hotels', 'parking Basel', 'Radon'. German terms often match best.

catalogues.description: Optional subset of catalogue names to search (see the `catalogues_searched` field of a previous result)

query.description: What you are looking for, e.g. 'bicycle counts', 'Mietpreise', 'noise map'

name: find_data
title: Find Swiss data across every catalogue
